title: An explicit noncoordinate polynomial with affine three-space zero fibre

abstractEnglish: We construct an explicit counterexample to the Abhyankar–Sathaye conjecture: a noncoordinate polynomial in four complex variables whose zero fibre is affine three-space. Adjoining variables gives counterexamples in every ambient dimension at least four.
